newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Pingguo Aluminium records 1996 net profit.
newsitem.headline: China's Pingguo Aluminium records 1996 net profit.

text.p: China's Pingguo Aluminium Co, a major nonferrous metal producer, recorded a net profit in 1996 despite heavy reliance on bank loans, the official China Economic Times reported on Saturday.
Pingguo posted a net profit of 235 million yuan in 1996 after boosting sales of its products and starting to pay back bank loans to reduce its payment burden, the report said.
The company had invested 4.29 billion yuan in a project, all from bank loans, which caused capital flow problems, it said.
But since 1995, the firm has trimmed staff and shifted to more market-oriented policies to be profitable, the newspaper said.
